ANALYSIS (pair 1): Lambert‑Eaton myasthenic syndrome is a neuromuscular, often paraneoplastic disorder; naming a primary bronchogenic lung carcinoma (even though LEMS is commonly associated with small‑cell lung cancer) is not the same diagnosis. They are different entities (one is a neurologic/paraneoplastic syndrome, the other a primary malignancy).

VERDICT (pair 1): INCORRECT

ANALYSIS (pair 2): Acalculous cholecystitis is an acute inflammatory disease of the gallbladder without gallstones. Acute delirium due to systemic infection/sepsis is a neuropsychiatric manifestation of systemic illness. These are distinct diagnoses and not clinically equivalent.

VERDICT (pair 2): INCORRECT
